description: Weekday and date contradict each other (4 October 2026 is a Sunday).

expected.notes: Two readings exist (Saturday 3rd or Sunday 4th) and the script gives no way to ask. A naive agent trusts the weekday or the number and books a day the caller may not mean. Never guess a date.
